policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.

DATA_DIR.holds: 1D_diff-sorp_NA_NA.h5, 2D_diff-react_NA_NA.h5, 2D_rdb_NA_NA.h5, downloaded from DaRUS doi:10.18419/darus-2986 and md5-checked against pdebench/data_download/pdebench_data_urls.csv

policy.forbidden: the PDEBench paper's result tables, the pretrained models of DaRUS doi:10.18419/darus-2987, or other published PDEBench results

tasks.task_prompt: Train and evaluate with the config pdebench/models/config/args/config_diff-sorp.yaml and the overrides `model_name=FNO` on 1D_diff-sorp_NA_NA.h5; pdebench/models/metrics.py computes the RMSE.

outputs.<model_name>.pt: the trained model checkpoint train.py saves
outputs.<model_name>.pickle: the errors train.py pickles after evaluation
outputs.Results.csv: the CSV pdebench/models/analyse_result_forward.py writes from that pickle

tasks.task_prompt: Train and evaluate with the config pdebench/models/config/args/config_diff-sorp.yaml and the overrides `model_name=Unet ar_mode=True pushforward=True unroll_step=20` on 1D_diff-sorp_NA_NA.h5; pdebench/models/metrics.py computes the RMSE.
